scope: Predeclared Stage-1 K12 language-composition sensitivity side study

selection.method: equal-weight mean across the frozen typology, genealogy, geography, and script distance matrices

data_contract.release: one common physical K200 successor release shared by compact and diverse
data_contract.physical_capacity: elementwise maximum across reference, compact, and diverse exposure requirements
data_contract.sampling_policy: document-level alpha=0.3 sampling with exact largest-remainder 32B exposure quotas

evaluation_contract.primary_metric: equal-language mean ATLAS-Tao unigram-adjusted held-out loss

analysis_contract.moe_gain: loss(E1)-loss(E32) within an arm, seed, and horizon
analysis_contract.reporting: three seedwise contrasts plus mean, sample standard deviation, and range
analysis_contract.significance_policy: no significance inference from languages or nested checkpoint readouts

execution_contract.parallelism: E1, E16, and E32 trajectories are dependency-eligible together within one arm/seed wave
execution_contract.retention: after all six K196 evaluations, remove each trunk and five nonterminal branches; retain only its 16B branch
execution_contract.production_authorization: explicit hash-bound authorization file required after four real-data smokes

language_composition_design.claim_boundary: This is a three-seed B-ladder sensitivity study of the frozen K12 compositions, not a language-level significance test, a full-grid invariance claim, or a new LR-selection experiment.
